selected_bottleneck: changeset-control-path-boundary-integrity（变更集控制路径边界完整性）
selected_problem: After the federation boundary was closed on fresh main, the effectful ChangesetStore.stage layer still accepted direct staged writes to .git/config and case variants such as .GIT/config because it enforced repository escape/symlink/type boundaries but did not enforce the repository's existing blocked control-path rule. NorthStarRunner.stage can reach this layer directly, so federation filtering alone was not an end-to-end invariant.
decision_basis: The same control directories are already hidden from workspace observation and blocked from federated proposal targets; this closes the effectful staging gap instead of defining a new product or development architecture.
A staged .git path can target repository metadata or hooks inside the workspace, so allowing it would weaken user-sovereignty and delivery-boundary guarantees.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502, so this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY（DWAC 源码契约重放） and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.

pre_fix_reality.source_observation: ChangesetStore.stage normalized relative paths and rejected repository escapes, duplicate/overlapping paths, invalid ancestors and non-file targets, but had no blocked control-segment check; WorkspaceService.ancestorState treats an ordinary in-root .git directory as a valid directory ancestor.
pre_fix_reality.impact: direct staged changes could cross the control-path boundary even after federation normalization rejected the same target

change: ChangesetStore.stage now fails closed with BLOCKED_CHANGE_PATH when any canonical path segment case-folds to the repository's established control/generated directory set (.git, node_modules, .next, dist, build, runtime-data, .venv).

validation.node_check: PASS on the exact proposed core/changesets.mjs content
validation.focused_guard_replay: PASS: .git/config, .GIT/config, src/.GiT/hooks/pre-commit, NODE_MODULES/pkg/index.js and .NeXt/cache/meta all fail closed; src/ok.mjs remains accepted

truth_boundary: This makes the existing control-path invariant hold at changeset staging. It does not define a complete credential-write policy, filesystem-wide case/Unicode identity, repository-context ranking, parser-grade module semantics, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
